responsibility: Declares an older non-tokenized lexical analyzer interface that reads Modula-2 source as raw symbol strings rather than enumerated token kinds. It exposes source open/close, current and previous symbol buffers, simple symbol comparison and pushback, and a direct source-line error display routine, distinguishing it from the newer buffered token stream in `M2LexBuf`.
same_name_distinction: Definition module for the older M2Lex scanner pair: it declares the raw symbol-string lexer API, exported symbol buffers, and pushback/error-display routines, while `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2Lex.mod` performs the actual character-by-character scanning and line buffering.
